function checkUserNameType(username) {
    if (/^(\d{13})$/.test(username)) return "BAN";
    if(/^(04\d{8})$/.test(username)) return "MB";
    if((/^\s*[\w\-\+_]+(\.[\w\-\+_]+)*@[\w\-\+_]+\.[\w\-\+_]+(\.[\w\-\+_]+)*\s*$/.test(username))&!(/^\s*[\w\-\+_]+(\.[\w\-\+_]+)*@(telstra|bigpond)\.[\w\-\+_]+(\.[\w\-\+_]+)*\s*$/.test(username))) return "EMAIL";
    return "";
}

function submitLoginForm(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if(!LoginForm.validate())return;
    var usernameInput = $('#maonboardingloginForm #username').val().replace(/[\s\t]/g, "");
    var username = usernameInput.toLowerCase();
    var errorFlag = checkUserNameType(username);
    $("#loginFailUrl").val($("#loginFailUrl").val().split("?flag=")[0]+"?flag="+errorFlag);
    var loginButton = $("#login-maonboarding-btn");
    loginButton.unbind("click");
    var isUserWhiteListed = false;
    if(Feature.isEnabled('filterCookieRedirectToCipPlatform')) {
        var partsOfStr = usersWhiteListed.split(',');
        partsOfStr.forEach(function(element) {
            if (username.indexOf(($.trim(element)).toLowerCase()) == 0) {
                isUserWhiteListed = true;
                createCookieR("rproute","idrp","");
                $('#password-validation-msg').hide();
                var gotoUrl = decodeURIComponent($("#maonboardingloginForm input[name=goto]").val());
                gotoUrl +=  "#login_hint=" + usernameInput;
                if($('#maonboardingloginForm #rememberMe').attr('checked')) {
                    gotoUrl +=  "&remember_username=true";
                } else {
                    gotoUrl +=  "&remember_username=false";
                }
                location.href = gotoUrl;
            }
        });
    }

    if(!isUserWhiteListed){
        $('#login-maonboarding-btn').text(loginSignInButtonText);
        createCookieR("rproute","raarp","");
        if((username.length > 0) && ($("#maonboardingloginForm #password").is(":hidden"))) {
            $('#tPassword').show();
            $('#password-validation-msg').removeClass('password-hidden');
            $('input[type="password"]').attr('required', '');
        } else if((username.length > 0) && ($("#maonboardingloginForm #password").is(":visible")) && ($.trim($('#maonboardingloginForm #password').val()).length > 0)){
            $('#maonboardingloginForm').submit();
        }
    }

    setTimeout(function(){
        LoginForm.toggleTopError(true);
        $('#error_box span.heading.signin-error').text("Sorry, your login request timed out, please try again.");
        Telstra.omniturePageAndErrorTracking("TD:TR:TR:myaccount:login - my account - login failed", "MyAcctV2-LoginFailed-Normal");
        loginButton.bind("click",submitLoginForm);},60000);
}

function setRememberMeCookie() {
    if ($("#maonboardingloginForm #rememberMe")[0].checked) {
        var username = $('#maonboardingloginForm #username');
        $.remeberme.setCookie(username);
    }
}


$(document).ready(function() {

    // project 'caiman' functionality

    // 'dont have an account' slider
    $('button.t-slide-tab--open').click(function() {
        $('main.t-main').attr("data-t-slide-open", true);
    });
    $('button.t-slide-tab--close').click(function() {
        $('main.t-main').attr("data-t-slide-open", false);
    });

    // form field handling

    $('input[name="username"]').bind('invalid', function() {
        showErrorWithUnderline(usernameErrorSelectors);
        return false;
    });

    $('input[name="username"]').bind('input', function() {
        if ($('div#tUsername').hasClass('mdc-text-field--invalid')) {
            clearErrorWithUnderline(usernameErrorSelectors);
        }
        return false;
    });

    $('input[name="username"]').bind('focus', function() {
        $('label[for="username"]').addClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above');
    });

    $('input[name="username"]').bind('blur', function() {
        if (!this.value) {
            $('label[for="username"]').removeClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above');

        }
    });

    $('input[type="password"]').bind('invalid', function() {
        showErrorWithUnderline(passwordErrorSelectors);
        return false;
    });

    $('input[name="password"]').bind('input', function() {
        if ($('div#tPassword').hasClass('mdc-text-field--invalid')) {
            clearErrorWithUnderline(passwordErrorSelectors);
        }
        return false;
    });

    $('input[name="password"]').bind('focus', function() {
        $('label[for="password"]').addClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above');
    });

    $('input[name="password"]').bind('blur', function() {
        if (!this.value) {
            $('label[for="password"]').removeClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above');

        }
    });

    setTimeout(positionLabelsInResponseToBrowserAutofill(), 100);
});

function showErrorWithUnderline(selectors) {

    var divSelector = selectors.divSelector;
    var paragraphSelector = selectors.paragraphSelector;

    var errorParagraph = $(paragraphSelector);
    var errorSpan = $(paragraphSelector + ' span.t-validator');
    var inputDiv = $(divSelector);
    var inputDivUnderline = $(divSelector + ' div.mdc-text-field__bottom-line');

    $('form#maonboardingloginForm').removeClass('t-login-form--no-errors');
    errorParagraph.css('visibility', 'visible');
    errorParagraph.css('opacity', '1');
    errorParagraph.attr('data-t-validated', 'false');
    errorSpan.attr('data-t-val-status', 'invalid');
    errorSpan.attr('data-t-val-hide', 'false');
    inputDiv.addClass('mdc-text-field--invalid');
    inputDivUnderline.addClass('mdc-text-field__bottom-line--active');
}

function clearErrorWithUnderline(selectors) {

    var divSelector = selectors.divSelector;
    var paragraphSelector = selectors.paragraphSelector;

    var errorParagraph = $(paragraphSelector);
    var errorSpan = $(paragraphSelector + ' span.t-validator');
    var inputDiv = $(divSelector);
    var inputDivUnderline = $(divSelector + ' div.mdc-text-field__bottom-line');

    errorParagraph.css('visibility', 'hidden');
    errorParagraph.css('opacity', '0');
    errorParagraph.removeAttr('data-t-validated');
    errorSpan.removeAttr('data-t-val-status', 'invalid');
    errorSpan.removeAttr('data-t-val-hide', 'false');
    inputDiv.removeClass('mdc-text-field--invalid');
    inputDivUnderline.removeClass('mdc-text-field__bottom-line--active');
}

function positionLabelsInResponseToBrowserAutofill() {
    // autofills
    if ($.browser.webkit) {
        if (undefined !== $("#username:-webkit-autofill").length && $("#username:-webkit-autofill").length == 1 && !($('label[for="username"]').hasClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above'))) {
            $('label[for="username"]').addClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above');
        }

        if (undefined !== $("#password:-webkit-autofill").length && $("#password:-webkit-autofill").length == 1 && !($('label[for="password"]').hasClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above'))) {
            $('label[for="password"]').addClass('mdc-text-field__label--float-above');
        }
    }
}

$(document).ready(function() {

    if (isMobile()) {
        $(document).scroll(function() {
            var loginButtonPosition = document.getElementById("login-maonboarding-btn").getBoundingClientRect();
            var triggerPoint = loginButtonPosition.top + 330;
            var scrollPosition = window.screen.availHeight + window.scrollY;

            if (scrollPosition > triggerPoint) {
                if ($(".persistentChatContainer").css("left") == "500px") {
                    $(".persistentChatContainer").css("left", "0px");
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        $(".persistentChatContainer").css("left", "unset");
                    } , 2000);
                };
                $('.persistentChatBtnContainer').fadeIn();
            } else {
                $('.persistentChatBtnContainer').fadeOut();
            }

        });
    }
});

function isMobile() {
    if (/((ipad|iphone|ipod|android|windows phone|BB\d+|blackberry[ ]?[0-9][0-689][0-9]{2}).*mobile)|.*hd7/i.test(navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase())) {
        return true;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
}
